_meta.note: County-grain housing, income, and risk data for the Assignment Compass. Keys per county: r=ACS median gross rent, z=ZORI rent, v=ACS median home value, h=ZHVI value, i=median household income, p=population, c=mean commute minutes, t=median annual real estate taxes, k=FEMA NRI high-risk flags (WF wildfire, FL riverine flood, CF coastal flood, EQ earthquake, HU hurricane, TO tornado, HA hail). States: r/v/i same idea + s=combined state and avg local sales tax %.
_meta.nriSource: FEMA National Risk Index county layer (FEMA_NationalRiskIndex FeatureServer), flags = Very High or Relatively High rating
_meta.salesTaxSource: Tax Foundation 2025 combined state + avg local
